responsibilities: Leads and participates in the design, development, testing and implementation of business solutions using collaboration tools that focus on speed to market, return on investment and delivery of business value. Collaborate with technical teams to understand application capabilities, environment set up and defect fixes.

Creates interaction models and interface designs for IT projects based on established standards, business and technical requirements and input from functional team members. Demonstrate these models to the users to ensure that user expectations are met.

Ensure that software products and solutions are appropriately tested to meet functional (usability) and technical (performance) requirements. Create test cases, test scripts and defect reports. Execute test scripts and document progress and results. Assist testers during the testing phase to ensure that the users understand the changes and/or new features.
Research and identifies emerging technologies, coordinate demonstrations, and proof of concept initiatives.
Effectively articulates project nuances and complexities to management, stakeholders and colleagues while being responsive and sensitive to underlying politics.

Elicits, documents, and analyzes business requirements on information technology projects to recommend business and information technology solutions. Assesses business problems and process gaps; identifies opportunities for new requirements. Collaborate with business analysts to understand business requirements and objectives.
Analyzing reporting requirements and translating these requirements into technical requirements.
Designing solutions to satisfy the visualization and reporting requirements using best practices.
Developing solutions for these deliverables using Business Objects, Power BI, SQL, KSH and other technologies.
Testing solutions to ensure that dashboards and reports meet requirements and achieve the desired outcomes.
Implementing/Migrating the business intelligence dashboards and reports to other environments and providing documentation for users.
Supporting the reports (outside of working hours if needed) by addressing scheduling and run-time issues raised by the users or FIT personnel.
Collaborating and communicating with management, end users, the Solutions Delivery Office, data analysts, and other technologists to ensure the success of the project.
Providing statuses and updates to management as required.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: business solutions using collaboration tools that focus on speed to market, return on investment and delivery of business value
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: "Speed to market" is named as a design goal, while a whole bullet is given to test cases, test scripts and defect reports plus output reconciliation.
evidence.domain_risk: NYC Department of Finance (DOF) is responsible for administering the tax revenue laws of the city fairly, efficiently, and transparently to instill public confidence and encourage compliance
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Reporting on city tax revenue administration — errors land on public revenue figures and statutory compliance.
evidence.collaboration_width: Data Integration team; business analysts; Solutions Delivery Office; data analysts; FIT personnel
evidence.data_team_maturity: FIT's Web Application and Data Warehouse Development and Support unit, seeks a Business Intelligence Developer for the FIT Data Integration and Business Intelligence Team (FIT DIBI).
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named sub-units with distinct charters — a Data Integration team, a BI team, a Solutions Delivery Office — inside an established IT division.
evidence.jd_authorship: Developing solutions for these deliverables using Business Objects, Power BI, SQL, KSH and other technologies.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The preferred-skills list is unusually specific about the actual migration task — rebuilding Crystal Syntax formulas and legacy SQL into Universes and WebI.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: use Power BI and Business Objects to develop data visualizations, dashboards, and reports to help stakeholders glean business and operational insights from data
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The named collaborators are the Data Integration team, business analysts, data analysts and other technologists inside the IT division.
evidence.autonomy_level: Analyzing reporting requirements and translating these requirements into technical requirements.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Work arrives as elicited requirements and the role reports to a Director; the verbs are analyse, translate, design to spec and support.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI is not mentioned anywhere in the posting.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensure that software products and solutions are appropriately tested to meet functional (usability) and technical (performance) requirements. Create test cases, test scripts and defect reports.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is a full responsibility bullet the candidate owns, including writing test cases and reconciling old against new report outputs.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Supporting the reports (outside of working hours if needed) by addressing scheduling and run-time issues raised by the users or FIT personnel.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Out-of-hours support for report run-time failures is an operational reliability concern; compliance appears only in the agency's mission statement.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Implementing/Migrating the business intelligence dashboards and reports to other environments and providing documentation for users.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The preferred skills describe a legacy Crystal/Business Objects migration in detail — this is a conversion job on an existing estate.
evidence.work_arrangement: This position may be eligible for remote work up to 2 days per week, pursuant to the Remote Work Pilot Program agreed between the City and the Collective Bargaining Unit
evidence.loss_aversion: "Proficiency in comparing data outputs between the old reports and modified reports to ensure accuracy" — output reconciliation during migration is a named preferred skill.
